name: Detroit Furniture Inc
old_description: Furnish your living room in one easy step with coordinated living room sets from Detroit Furniture in Dearborn, MI. Our sets include matching sofas, loveseats, and accent pieces designed to work together, so your room looks pulled together from day one without the hassle of mixing and matching individual pieces. Buying a living room set is also one of the most cost-effective ways to furnish a room — you get a complete, coordinated look for less than purchasing each piece separately. Our sets come in a range of styles from casual and contemporary to traditional and transitional, with fabric, leather, and performance material options. Whether you're moving into a new home, updating your current space, or furnishing a rental property, a living room set makes the process simple. Visit our furniture showroom in Dearborn to see complete living room sets displayed in room-style settings. Shop in store or online with delivery and financing available.
about:
Detroit Furniture Inc operates a furniture showroom at 6060 Miller Road in Dearborn, Michigan. The business was founded by an industry veteran with more than 25 years of experience, though the exact founding year and founder’s name are not disclosed. Ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status are not specified in public sources.

The company retails residential furniture, carrying brands such as Ashley Furniture. Its product range includes living room sets (sofas, loveseats, accent pieces), bedroom sets, dining room furniture, entertainment units, and youth bedroom sets. The showroom displays coordinated room settings, and the company offers white‑glove delivery with setup, assembly‑free options, and financing plans. Inventory is kept in stock for immediate purchase or delivery.

Detroit Furniture serves primarily residential customers — homeowners, renters, and property managers furnishing homes or rental units. The retailer also accommodates online shoppers with shipping and in‑store pickup options. No industrial or contract‑manufacturing clients are indicated.

The business emphasizes a hassle‑free buying experience: coordinated sets that eliminate mixing‑and‑matching, free delivery and setup, and knowledgeable, non‑pushy sales staff. These service elements are presented as the core differentiators rather than any proprietary manufacturing capability.
